description: A small white plastic base with a few upright posts sits on the yellow surface, and a separate white rectangular piece lies in front of it. The right hand moves forward and grasps the rectangular piece as a right-hand object, lifts it up and over the base, and lowers it vertically to align and press it into a slot near the tall post on the right side, while the left hand rests on the base to steady it; the right hand then releases and pulls back.
